notes.title: Update 00.03.00
notes.content:
Developer note: It’s been a while since the last game update, but I am back into full swing working on Brimstone! I’m excited to bring this update to everyone and hope that it gives new players something more engaging to do. Hopefully it keeps more people around and we can gain some more support for the game! I am hard at work on a few new features including a tutorial for new players, Matchmaking for online matches and a cool new single player campaign. Thanks everyone for the support so far, I can't wait to get Brimstone Brawlers to the point where we all want it! 

AI Controlled Player Characters

 The first iteration of Player Bots have been added to Brimstone. These should allow players to add more variety to their local and online games and even give solo players something more challenging to fight (compared to the nothing they could fight before :P). 
 Bots can be added to any Combat Gamemode via using the “Add Bot” button in the lobby screen. 
 Bot settings can be updated by clicking the cog next to bot player names in the lobby.


 https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExMTdkZmQxMzA3NDY2YzRhNmNhZTkwZGNmNGE4ODJiYTU3OWMyZjI1OCZjdD1n/TZvmwUDW1Mo8yTASge/giphy.gif

Developer note: This is only the first step of AI within Brimstone and they are pretty dumb at the moment. I will be hard at work adding more behaviours, play styles and difficulty levels to the player AI. Please feel free to send any feedback to me via the Brimstone Discord.

General

 Brimstone now uses Unreal Engine 5. Users should now experience enhanced levels of visual fidelity along with performance gains. 
 Fixed bug where characters would not die if their health was exactly 0.
 Fixed bug where gamepad inputs would not map correctly ingame settings menu.

Developer note: Upgrading to Unreal 5 has significantly influenced my ability to keep developing Brimstone Brawlers. It has taken a little while to get to this point but I am extremely happy with having the game run in the latest version of the engine for several reasons. The first being all the awesome stuff they keep adding to the engine in its latest versions. It also makes features like Matchmaking, Bots and a Single Player Campaign all easier to develop in the future along with a bunch of cool new tech-art possibilities. On a personal level, I work with UE5 full time at my day job. Having the same development environment there and at home significantly reduces the brain effort required to boot up Brimstone to do 
development after work. :)

notes.title: 00.02.07 Monster Patch + Hotfixes
notes.content:
Monster makes an entrance

The Monster is entering the game as an work-in-progress brawler. His skill set is still under development and community feedback will be key to the design of this new brawler. Please note that Monster wont be able to contribute to challenge mode leader boards until he has been balanced.

Static Charge

Dealing damage will grow Static Charge (stacking to 3 times) and can be expended to empower Grounding. 

Punch

A slow, heavy punch dealing 14/16/18/20 damage depending on level of Static Charge.

Grounded

The Monster slams his fists into the ground, causing all Static Charge to disperse into the earth. Deals 10/15/20/25 dmg depending on Static Charge level. If the Monster has at least one charge, lightning will tear from the sky dealing 10/15/20/25 dmg to brawlers hit, while stunning Airborne targets for 1.2s.

Hurl

Hurls a close enemy directly up into the air dealing 20 dmg applying Airborne until they hit the ground.

Ram (Movment)

A short dash forward, ramming enemies for 10 dmg. The sudden movement will fill Static Charge to full. 

Enrage (Ultimate)

The Monster will enrage, causing all damage and crowd control to be halved. The Monster will always have full Static Charge while enraged.



General


 Spawn invulnerable buff is now working correctly against CC and damage.
 Reduced Ghost Train drop chance to 5% (down from 10%).
 Spectators will now see "Game" at the end of matches rather than "Defeat".

 Self casting Pyrogoo will now throw it directly down.

notes.title: Play For Free FAQ
notes.content:
Attention Brawlers!

This Thursday we will be updating Brimstone Brawlers so people can Play For Free as well as launching the Founder’s Edition upgrade! Whether you are a seasoned Brawler or just arrived at Brimstone by Steam train we hope this FAQ answers those burning questions!

I currently own Brimstone Brawlers - what happens?

Firstly, you get a high five cause you’re a legend. Secondly, your game will automatically update to the Founder’s Edition - Steam was very helpful in making this process smooth for everyone.

What is the Founder’s Edition?

The Founder’s Edition includes ALL current and future content. At the minimum we expect a total of 15 Brawlers (five included in Free to Play, seven available now in Founder’s and three in development). It may potentially also include future stages and modes. We are of course passionate about this game and hoping we can support this game for years - so hey if we are still making Brawlers in five years you’ll get them too - at no additional cost.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1338700/Brimstone_Brawlers__Founders_Edition/

What is the Play For Free version?

As the name suggests it's where anyone can play… for free! Think of this as like a super demo where you get access to a fairly large portion of the current game to see if it’s something you would like to support by upgrading to the Founder’s Edition.

Play For Free? You mean Free To Play right?

Kind of, Steam may label it as such however we want to differentiate ourselves from games labelled as ‘Free To Play’ - those games tend to be online-only and rely on microtransactions, loot boxes, “surprise mechanics” etc and we feel this kind of approach often takes focus away from the actual gaming experience - and Brimstone Brawlers is an awesome game. We’ve loved and played many types of those games but we feel they’re not the right fit for us and Brimstone Brawlers. Instead you can Play For Free, and if you’re enjoying the game upgrade to Founder’s Edition to get all current and future content.

Which Brawlers are included in the Play For Free version?

We want to offer a variety of the fun and peculiar characters that tailor to a variety of play styles and skill levels. First up there is the Engineer who specialises in close range melee combat for those that enjoy getting in the thick of combat. Next is the Vampire is a more mobile melee character focusing that is super fun to use to push other players off ledges! For those that prefer a bit of range the Bomber is a bit more tactful by utilising bombs to cause large area-of-effect damage and explosive charges to displace opponents. The Plague Doctor is designed to enter and exit combat wearing down opponents over time before going in for the final blow. Finally we have the Boxer that has a much higher skill barrier but is able to dominate if played right. We believe this is a great selection of characters to introduce players to Brimstone Brawlers. Please note we may change or add to this selection over time.

Can people with the Founder’s Edition play with friends on the Play For Free version?

Yes absolutely. Regardless if you have the Play For Free version or upgraded to Founder’s Edition you will be able to play with anyone else. For current Founders of the game this is the perfect time to introduce your friends to Brimstone Brawlers to play with. ;)

Why should I upgrade to the Founder’s Edition?

You immediately get access to the entire Brawler roster. Plus you’re supporting us so we can make the game more awesome and create even more content than has been announced so you can enjoy that in the future - at no additional cost.

Will the Founder’s Edition include microtransactions?

No. You upgrade to Founder’s edition and you get everything. New Brawlers, new modes, new maps, new challenges etc. We would love to also include some cool cosmetics but they’re more dependent on the game’s success - however you’ll have to earn these by playing the game!

I’m loving Brimstone Brawlers! How can I support development further?

Glad to hear it! Honestly right now the best way to support us is to tell everyone you know - your friends, family and streamers you watch! Or heck, yell out ‘Brimstone Brawlers’ out of your window once a day.

Is Brimstone Brawlers online only?

Nope - you can play with up to 4 players locally.

Does the Play For Free version include local multiplayer?

Yes you can play locally with friends for some fun 4 player matches!

Does the Play For Free version include online multiplayer?

Yes Play For Free players can join or host online lobbies to play with friends (or strangers). We recommend checking out our growing Discord community if you’d like to find some new friends to play regularly with!

Wow. There’s too much content - I don’t even need to buy the game!

That’s more so a statement than a question, however if you don’t want to upgrade to get access to all future content as well as support us that’s cool - instead just tell ten awesome friends and we’ll call it even!

Does the Play For Free version have a demo timer?

No, you can play for as long as you want! In fact, play more - it helps us in the Steam algorithm!

What modes does the Play For Free version include?

In the Play For Free version you can play:
	Multiplayer:
Brawl (Most kills wins) - local or online with solo or team variations
Deathmatch (Individual lives) - local or online with solo or team variations
Bamball (our version of Football!) - local or online with solo or team variations
Single player:
Steambot Smash Challenge - test your skills in this everlasting horde challenge
Target Trash Challenge - think a 3D version of Smash the Targets ;)

Will there be microtransactions?

We have no plans yet. We might consider it past launch - but just as a reminder if you upgrade to the Founder’s you will get all future content (although you might have to actually play and do challenges to unlock them - like the good old days).

Will the Founder’s Edition be available after exiting Early Access?
 
We might make a variation of the Founder’s Edition available when we transition out of Early Access, however with the amount of additional content and polish in the final version we will need to raise the price accordingly, so probably upgrade now if you’re having fun!

What can we expect after Early Access?

One of our core values is transparency - we have lots of cool and exciting new Brawlers and ideas we would love to add however unfortunately it does come down to the success of the game, so please do tell your friends!

If you have any other questions please feel free to ask on the Steam boards or join us in a conversation on our Discord!

See you on the streets of Brimstone!

Ategig

notes.title: 0.0.104 - Righteous Fire
notes.content:
General

 Buffs can now change the duration of crowd control effects.
 Hiding HUD will now also hide combat text and chat.
 Players can now view brawler information while set to “ready” in local games.


Brawlers

(New) Battle Priest 
The Battle Priest has entered the city, ready to purge it with righteous fire.

 Divine Reckoning

 Consecration

 Holy Shield
Defend yourself with a holy shield, reducing all damage and crowd control by 50% while granting Knockback Immunity.

 Lights Bulwark (Ultimate)
(Likely to change) - Grants total Immunity for all team members for 4s.

Countess

 Brambles will now lash out at the start of Barbed Growth instead at the end of its duration.


Vampire

 Health increase to 180 (up from 160).

notes.title: 0.0.102 - Change is Strange!
notes.content:
General

 Updated UI and HUD elements for online matches (these are still WIP).
 Added chat window mid match, accessible by pressing Enter (click to chat disabled mid game).


Brawlers

Alchemist

 Store/Mix Potion cooldown reduced to 1s (down from 2s).
 Reduced Purple Potion knockback by 25%.


Bomber

 Pyrogood radius increased to 110 (up from 90).


Boxer

 New version of Boxer has been added, temporary called Turbo Boxer.
 Combos mechanic has been removed.
 Side Step will now trigger a combo finisher for 3s after it is used.
 Casting Side Step 3 times in a row will trigger flurry if a combo finisher is used.


Butcher

 Picking up a thrown cleaver will no longer trigger Super Cleave. It will now remove up to 2s off the cooldown of the Butcher’s next Throw Cleaver ability.
 Throw Cleaver’s bleed damage reduced to 2 dpt (down from 5) and its duration has been reduced to 5s (down from 8s).
 Picking up a thrown cleaver now instantly causes 2x the remaining damage left and triggers GCD.
 Peculiar Haunch self targeting now slows the Butcher by 50%.


Maps

 Manor visual update.


Bug Fixes

notes.title: 0.0.100 The Traveller's Coming
notes.content:
General

 Large reworks of netcode - decreasing bandwidth usage and latency.
 A 5 second cooldown has been added to the Attention Bell in the character select screen.


Maps

Alchemist Store

The Alchemist Store is making its first appearance in this build of Brimstone! We are testing basic layout of this map and there will be many more updates to come!

Brawlers

Boxer

The Boxer has undergone some large design changes, with reduced cooldown times to enable faster weaving of combos. To balance this, most of the status effects of his abilities and combos have been reduced, creating a faster paced play style. We are still zeroing in on some of the numbers so keep the feedback coming in!

 Cross Knock Back reduced by 50%.
 Uppercuts Knock Up has been reduced by 30%.
 Super Cross Knock Back reduced by 30%.
 Discombobulates Stun duration reduced to 1 s (down from 1.8s).


Plague Doctor

The Plague Doctor has been simplified, streamlining some of his abilities to make him more fun and engaging to play.

 Leeches will no longer steal buffs from from brawlers hit.
 Wax Coat will now dispell debuffs and place them in the Plague Doctor's next Leeches ability. New "success" animation added if a debuff is captured.


Wraith

 Global cooldown for all abilities increased to 1s (up from 0.5s).
 Apparition can now be cast ignoring the Global Cooldown. This will allow players to react a lot faster.
 Haunts max bounce count reduced to 2 (down from 3).


Bug Fixes


 Gravy Train slow can now be dispelled.

notes.title: Alpha Update 0.0.98.3
notes.content:
Alpha 0.0.98.3 Alchemical Plague Fire 2

We have been hard at work on the next update for Brimstone! You can find some general gameplay improvements below:

General


 Joining a new lobby will now assign a random brawler.
 Added random brawler selection in lobby.
 Selected brawlers will now persist through games.
 Fixed bug where mouse interaction would disable after using a gamepad in the same play session.
 Blood decals will be orientated correctly.
 Local and online games will now have the same camera angle.


Gameplay


 Brawlers will no longer spawn in locations occupied by other brawlers or residual abilities.
 Fixed bug allowing items to be thrown while stunned.
 Team kills with now add negative kill score.
 Damage done to team members is no longer counted towards score.
 Explosive barrels now cause Small Knockback.
 Buffs and debuffs will correctly display refreshes on brawlers.


Items


 Teleporter will now correctly Fizzle Out on clients.


Maps

Courtyard:


 Top right Plague Barrel will now correctly destroy the ground.
 Plague Barrels hp reduced to 50 (down from 100).


Brawlers

Alchemist


 Poison gas sound effects will now end when the Alchemist dies.


Butcher


 Cleave will now cause a Small Stun while a haunch is out, while knocking back when no weapon is equipped.
 Fixed a bug causing the Butcher to slide after casting Gravy Train.


Countess


 Bramble melee hit increased range and now does 30 damage (up from 10).
